description: Renders image, file, and generated stamp signing steps. Upload contract (Signing redesign phase 6): the upload is host-owned — the runner hands the picked IBrowserFile to the host (OnAttachmentSelected) and stores the host-returned url on the card; the file CONTENT is read at the host (Blazor Server streams browser files over SignalR with tight message limits). The component only ever reads a downscaled image thumbnail (RequestImageFileAsync) for the local preview. Without the resolver the picked files stay client-side metadata.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: Signing field represented by this step.

parameters.name: AllowMultiple
parameters.description: Whether file input allows multiple files.

parameters.name: AppearsOn
parameters.description: Short text describing where the field appears in the document.

parameters.name: Capture
parameters.description: The native capture attribute for mobile camera capture (Signing redesign phase 6, optional) — for example environment or user. Splatted on the native file input of Image fields only.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the shell element.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve localized field text and to format file sizes (cs-CZ renders "1,2 MB").

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when localized field text is missing.

parameters.name: MaxFileSize
parameters.description: Maximum accepted file size in bytes (Signing redesign phase 6). A larger file shows the localized "file is larger than …" message and never joins the attachments — the rejection happens BEFORE any host upload round-trip. NOTE: this is a CLIENT-REPORTED limit (the browser's declared size) and is UX only — the host must enforce the real limit via OpenReadStream(maxAllowedSize).

parameters.name: MaxFiles
parameters.description: Maximum number of attachments (Signing redesign phase 6). Overflowing files show the localized "up to {0} files" message and are rejected; the first files stay. The value is also the platform read budget (Math.Max(MaxFiles ?? 10, 1)) — a pick beyond the budget is refused by the platform itself and rejected wholesale.

parameters.name: StampValue
parameters.description: Generated stamp text or image identifier.

parameters.name: UploadUrlResolver
parameters.description: Host-provided upload resolver (Signing redesign phase 6): receives the picked file and returns the uploaded file's url, which the card then previews. TmSigningFormRunner passes its OnAttachmentSelected host hook through; a step without a resolver keeps the client-side-only placeholder behaviour. The file content is read by the HOST — never here.
